name: Points by Heat Size
author: Mauricio Bridge
description: Race points method whose table depends on how many pilots are in the heat (e.g. 4 pilots: 10,9,8,5 / 3 pilots: 10,8,5). Pilots with 0 laps are separated by holeshot time. Optional DNF rule: pilots short of the laps to finish get 0. Tables are editable in Settings.
